dedupe_keys.name: elevated collapse risk based on decaying aftershock hazard and damaged building fragilities

description: Elevated Collapse Risk Based on Decaying Aftershock Hazard and Damaged Building Fragilities is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Anne Hulsey, University of Auckland (aucklanduni.ac.nz). This paper proposes a framework to support post-earthquake building safety and reoccupancy decisions by quantifying the change in building collapse risk following a mainshock earthquake event. This risk may be exacerbated by both an increase in seismic hazard due to aftershock activity and a reduction in building collapse resistance due to structural damage. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Aftershock, Damaged Building, Risk of Collapse, Post-Earthquake Safety Decisions. Published 2023-11-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
